description.value: OAKBERRY AÇAI is a Brazilian-origin global açaí chain serving organic açaí bowls, smoothies, and snacks with unlimited toppings, located in the food court of the Metropolis at Metrotown mall in Burnaby. The brand sources its açaí from the Amazon region of Brazil and markets its products as vegan, antioxidant-rich, and free from artificial additives. Cyclists stopping at Metrotown can fuel up with a nutrient-dense bowl, though they would need to navigate mall parking and access.
